connections.to: sliding glass door with green valance
connections.how: With the mint armchair and mirrored wall on your left, walk straight past the dining table with white chairs on your left and the doorway with blue mat on your right.

connections.from: sliding glass door with green valance
connections.how: Turn around past the potted tree, walk forward with the dining table with white chairs on your left and mirrored wall on your right, and turn right before the mint armchair.
Pass through the doorway with white door and walk straight between the bed with pink throw on your left and the long white dresser with mirror on your right.

Turn around past the tv on white chest and doorway with white door, then walk down the narrow passage with the white desk with black chair and open closet with shelves on your right and the sliding pocket door on your left.
Continue straight past the corner vanity with mirrors through the doorway ahead.

Turn around between the white tiled shower and white bathtub, walk back out past the open closet with shelves on your left toward the bed with pink throw, and turn left between the bed and the long white dresser with mirror.

Exit the doorway with white door, turn left, and walk across the carpet with the mint armchair and cream sofa on your right and the dining table with white chairs and doorway with blue mat on your left onto the white tiled floor area.

With the front door with arched window behind you, follow the white tiled floor area past the small glass console table and arched wall cutout with vase on your left and the closed white door and patterned armchair on your right.
Walk forward past the brown fur rug and the white counter on your left and the patterned armchair on your right into the carpeted area.
Pass the tan draped armchair and mirrored wall above white cabinets on your right to enter the passage doorway ahead.
Walk forward along the patterned runner rug past the doorway with the black office chair and bed with pink cover on your right to reach the doorway at the end of the passage.
Turn around and walk back along the patterned runner rug toward the tan draped armchair, then turn right before exiting the passage.

connections.to: glass shower stall with grab bar
connections.how: Step past the white vanity cabinet and turn right, with the white toilet and exterior door with blinds on your left.

connections.from: glass shower stall with grab bar
connections.how: Step back out into the passage with the black office chair to your left, and walk straight out through the passage doorway.

From the carpeted area near the tan draped armchair, walk across the white tiled floor between the white counter on your right and the round table with rolling chairs and white refrigerator on your left.
Turn around near the white built-in wall oven and white dishwasher and walk back with the white counter on your left and the white refrigerator on your right.

walk_summary: Start by walking past the mint armchair and mirrored wall on the left, going between the dining table with white chairs on the left and doorway with blue mat on the right to reach the sliding glass door with green valance.
Turn around past the potted tree and walk back past the dining table with white chairs and mirrored wall, turning right before the mint armchair to go through the doorway with white door.
Walk straight between the bed with pink throw on the left and the long white dresser with mirror on the right to the window with vertical blinds.

Turn around past the tv on white chest and doorway with white door to face the bed with pink throw, then turn right and walk past the white desk with black chair, open closet with shelves, and sliding pocket door to the corner vanity with mirrors and white bathtub.
Turn around between the white tiled shower and white bathtub, walk back past the open closet with shelves toward the bed with pink throw, and exit left through the doorway with white door.

Turn left onto the carpet and walk past the mint armchair and cream sofa on the right and the doorway with blue mat on the left to reach the white tiled floor area at the front door with arched window.

Turn around at the front door with arched window and follow the white tiled floor area past the small glass console table and arched wall cutout with vase on the left and the closed white door and patterned armchair on the right toward the white counter.

Continue past the brown fur rug and white counter into the carpeted area with the tan draped armchair, patterned sofa, cream loveseat, light wood entertainment center, and round table with rolling chairs.
Walk past the tan draped armchair and mirrored wall above white cabinets through the passage doorway along the patterned runner rug.
Look right into the doorway with the black office chair and bed with pink cover, then look ahead into the end doorway with the bed with turquoise cover and tall light wood dresser.
Turn around and walk back along the patterned runner rug, turning right past the white vanity cabinet to view the white toilet, exterior door with blinds, and glass shower stall with grab bar.
Exit back into the passage and walk out past the tan draped armchair and mirrored wall above white cabinets into the main area.

Walk across the tiled floor past the round table with rolling chairs, going between the white counter and white refrigerator toward the white built-in wall oven, white dishwasher, and doorway with blue mat, then turn around to face the white refrigerator and round table with rolling chairs.
